"Also, a right frontal hemorrhagic lesion was observed." follows the two-month MRI sentence but names no modality or time of its own.
The Figure 1 callout is in the CT-before-surgery sentence; the caption's FLAIR and T2 MRI sections are not identified as the MRI done two months after the initial hemorrhage.
